# 2558. Take Gifts From the Richest Pile

## Solution 1 (time O(klogn), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def pickGifts(self, gifts, k):
        """
        :type gifts: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        q = [-t for t in gifts]
        heapq.heapify(q)
        while k:
            x = heapq.heappop(q)
            heapq.heappush(q, -int(sqrt(-x)))
            k -= 1
        return -sum(q)
```
